title: Refactor auth middleware and drop legacy cookie path
author: core-maintainer
body:
Cleans up the auth layer. Removes support for the legacy `session_id` cookie (deprecated in 1.3). Anyone still on cookie auth needs to migrate to bearer tokens.

No tests added — the existing auth integration tests cover this.
diff_summary: Removes cookie.ts entirely. Rewrites middleware.ts to only accept bearer tokens. Session parsing simplified.
